I had extremely frizzy and dry hair and wanted something that could make my hair more manageable without damaging it much.  My trichologist recommended Nanoplastia as the safest option available in the market compared to the rest, so I started looking for a good salon in Borivali–Kandivali–Malad. After a lot of research, I chose Radhika Thakkar’s salon because of their excellent reviews, affordable pricing, and the fact that they use Floractive — one of the best brands for Nanoplasty (unlike many others that use lower-grade products).
My experience was genuinely amazing. Raj and Aasma were super patient and answered all my queries throughout the process. I also met Radhika, who was extremely warm and guided me on post-care — what products to use, what to avoid, and how to maintain the results. The difference is clearly visible in the photos, and my hair looks and feels so much smoother and healthier now. The photo I have posted is after almost 3-4 wash and I absolutely love the results as I did not want poker straight hair but something which looks a little natural and that is exactly what they provided me with.
Highly recommended for anyone considering Nanoplastia and olaplex treatment, totally worth it! ✨
